root_cause.text: During multicast route replacement in `mlxsw_sp_mr_route_add`, the old route entry is removed from the list and freed without holding the `mr_table->route_list_lock`, while a concurrent worker (`mlxsw_sp_mr_stats_update`) traverses the same list under that lock, leading to a use-after-free.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states "One instance of list entry deletion (during route replace) was missed", and the patch adds `mutex_lock(&mr_table->route_list_lock)` and `mutex_unlock` around the `list_del(&mr_orig_route->node)` call in `mlxsw_sp_mr_route_add`. The KASAN report confirms the use-after-free occurs in `mlxsw_sp_mr_stats_update` (the list traversal) while the allocation and free both happen in `mlxsw_sp_mr_route_add`.
